track_A.name: Operation-level mechanism novelty versus parent overlap
track_A.unit: One supported change to an available action, coupled to opposing predictions and a feasible separating probe while the outcome stays fixed.
track_A.decision: Use recipe fidelity as admission, then independently test local operation distinctness against the full raw ordinary and both parent repertoires. No presumption that composition adds value.
track_A.recomposition: Keep the smallest action/prediction unit with attributable source residue; add the second technique only where it changes the action or its separating observation.

track_B.name: Trustworthy source, handoff and assessment execution
track_B.unit: One attributable valid proposal-to-Distill-to-fresh-builder chain plus immutable raw comparison and terminal review evidence.
track_B.decision: Honor declared branch access and exact source grammar; separately retain valid zero-card no-opening, missing, invalid and gated states. Only qualified raw chains and dual independent locks can support an addition judgment.
track_B.recomposition: Attach common facts, outcome constraints, source IDs, selected supplement, machine identity and first-save ancestry to the operation without importing another condition or DEV-generated content.

claims.claim: Current S04 explicitly attacks the new carrier dependency and accounts for actor labor and maintenance; R04 explicitly acknowledges this overlap.
claims.boundary: This establishes prompt-level overlap, not identical eventual operations. R04 earns no addition merely by attacking a carrier or adding a burden ledger; raw operation comparison remains necessary.

claims.claim: S02 already requests opposed demand accounts, return-link intervention and sham; S08 already requests two dependency-distinct futures, earliest divergence and a feasible present probe.
claims.boundary: R02 and R06 may chiefly add preservation through handoff. That can improve fidelity without changing an operation; do not count retained branch names as compositional benefit.

claims.claim: The current declared builder branch is residue alone for S06, R01 and R05, and summary for the other methods.
claims.boundary: R03 failure signatures and required rival accounts must survive in the assigned summary. A reference to source-bound residue in the first proposer prescription does not authorize exposing an omitted residue branch.

claims.claim: COMMON uses a shared action/probe/opposing-prediction form and tells each worker to use only its own condition instructions; O asks for routine fit and an ordinary operation.
claims.boundary: The inspected text does not contain specific other-technique hints for O. Actual literal prompts and case packets remain admission checks; neutral-looking common facts could still furnish technique-specific answers.

claims.claim: R08 requests a saved predeclared trigger before fresh confirmation, while the contract bars importing numeric DEV trigger content into another domain and describes cross-domain replication as fixed-method assessment.
claims.boundary: Freezing generative method wording is not the same as freezing an actual portable trigger rule. No scored synthetic generation demonstrates an executed trigger or observed harm boundary.

claims.claim: The contract distinguishes valid zero-card chains from missing/invalid/gated execution and makes incremental addition conditional on qualified composition, valid comparators, dual locks and distinction from EVERY raw ordinary/parent card.
claims.boundary: No-opening yields an explicit empty repertoire only for a valid comparator chain. Missing/invalid comparator yields null, uncertainty yields unknown, and equivalence yields no addition; none may be recoded into a favorable result.

proposals.prescription: Give R04 strongest duplicate scrutiny; R02 and R06 must show a changed move rather than prolonged preservation. R10 must add an anomaly-conditioned attribution operation beyond S09 ablation and S07 anomaly probing. Retain duplicate or no-opening where that change is absent.

proposals.decision: Keep handoff prescriptions inside the 132-role geometry
proposals.prescription: Carry R03 signature and R02/R06 incompatible accounts in summary; reserve residue-alone access for S06/R01/R05. R04 has a separate attacker ACCOUNT within existing stages, never an added native attacker role. Planned sham/ablation/parent controls remain within the one-card probe plan.

proposals.decision: Freeze an actual R08 trigger procedure or limit confirmation claims
proposals.prescription: Before source/method freeze and CONF, declare a domain-portable procedure F that maps explicitly admissible case observables to the detector, threshold derivation, sampling/order rule, comparator, rival predictions and dependency-free switch route. Freeze F prospectively; instantiate only from fresh case facts, record the actual rule before any confirmatory probe observation, and do not choose thresholds from results. If the supplied facts cannot instantiate F, retain no-opening/unknown rather than invent values.
proposals.limitation_if_not_adopted: With only current fixed generative instructions and case-local saved cards, claim fresh fixed-method generation and prospective trigger proposals. Do not claim confirmation of the DEV actual trigger, an identical cross-domain operational policy, observed threshold, or executed benefit.

proposals.decision: Maintain both tracks through the finite remaining cycles
proposals.prescription: Balancer1 and subsequent Proposer/Balancer cycles should separately record the operation-level novelty decision and the execution-trust decision; neither can stand in for the other. Stop after the declared three cycles and resolve any admission blocker without expanding scored attempts.

premortem: A faithful composition is counted as incremental novelty because its parent overlap was reduced to labels; require every raw O/parent operation in the pair qualification.
A mechanism seems novel only because the selected supplement omitted a parent-relevant detail; verify branch/source attribution without opening another condition to the worker.
Separate attacker wording silently adds a worker and breaches declared accounting; keep it a separate account inside R04's existing chain.
R08 freezes a vague instruction while choosing an actual threshold after seeing confirmatory observations; freeze a portable instantiation procedure or explicitly limit the replication claim.
Independent review is described as full blinding; opaque administrative labels do not remove semantic clues in raw operations.
A zero-card valid comparator is conflated with a missing one, converting null/unknown into addition; preserve distinct contract dispositions.

cycle_guard.native_role_accounting: Same running Proposer1 overhead role; no new native worker, subagent or scored call was used for this addendum.

first_save_ancestry.authorization: Parent follow-up explicitly required preserving the first save and allowed this separate exclusive addendum.

cycle_guard.addendum_save: Create-exclusive once with python3; no first-artifact overwrite.
cycle_guard.excluded: No runtime mutation or execution, old raw cases/proposals/grades, scored outputs, web or subagents.

conditional_gates.reason: Current method instructions were inspected; future raw operations, resources and opposed predictions remain unobserved.
Require both reviewers to find the qualified R card distinct from EVERY raw O and named-parent card; labels cannot qualify R04, R02, R06 or R10.
Only declared supplement plus common facts is available; exact allowed source IDs and correct case identity must be embedded and checked before dispatch.
Predeclare portable F and supported case instantiation before confirmatory observations, or report only fixed-method fresh generation and prospective case-local trigger proposals.
Both terminal saved raw DEV assessment locks must exist; fresh CONF workers receive no DEV generated content or grades.
Valid zero-card chain, missing/invalid/gated chain, null comparator judgment, unknown and no-addition remain different dispositions.
Preserve both track decisions in each cycle; depth is not permission for extra scored attempts.

recomposition.track_A: Recompose action, changed mechanism and separating probe with source-bound uncertainty; a second method is useful only if it changes that coherent unit.
recomposition.track_B: Recompose the valid declared chain, stable first-save bytes, terminal witnesses and independent whole-case comparison; no operation claim survives a missing execution boundary by relabeling.
recomposition.joint_rule: Mechanism novelty and trustworthy execution are necessary separately. Prompt fidelity without a changed operation is no addition; a promising operation without valid execution or comparators cannot yield a qualified addition.
recomposition.variety_limit: Separate synthetic domains and ten recipes expose local variety. They do not validate a general causal mechanism or identical operational threshold.

frame_expiry.track_A: Expire the action-level interpretation when source facts, available resources, outcome, carrier, link or regime changes; preserve the original local judgment.
frame_expiry.track_B: Expire comparability when declared source access, branch, literal method, identities, save ancestry, reviewer geometry or phase barrier changes; source/prompt drift blocks frozen execution.
frame_expiry.R08: The actual DEV trigger expires outside its sourced domain unless the predeclared F has a supported fresh-domain instantiation. Fixed-method transfer alone does not carry an operational threshold.
